# Sakuga

> AniCanon™'s design system for the web: typed, tree-shakeable React components in two libraries, the core (`@anicanon/sakuga/ui`) and AniCanonKit (`@anicanon/sakuga/anicanonkit`), built on AniCanon's tokens. Each component's README says what it is, when to use it and when not, how it works, its props (generated from the shipped types), an example that compiles, and how it is reached and read.

Import a component from its library, wrap the app in `<Sakuga>` (from `@anicanon/sakuga/ui`), and load `@anicanon/sakuga/tokens.css` and `@anicanon/sakuga/fonts.css` once.

## Core (`@anicanon/sakuga/ui`)

- [AudioPlayer](src/ui/AudioPlayer/README.md): A voice line or sound clip: a round play button, a `Waveform` you can click, drag or arrow through to seek, and the time.
- [Badge](src/ui/Badge/README.md): Badge is a small label laid over artwork: a duration, a view count, or New. Use it for a small label over artwork (a duration, a view count, New) and, on a surface, a state such as rendering or one that waits for you.
- [Button](src/ui/Button/README.md): Button runs an action with a text label: Play, Follow, Remind me, Done. Use it for an action with a word on it: the one main action of a view, the action beside it, and the confirmation in a dialog that deletes something.
- [Caption](src/ui/Caption/README.md): Caption is one subtitle line drawn over video. Use it for one subtitle line over an episode or a short, at most two lines, centred above the player controls.
- [CastAvatar](src/ui/CastAvatar/README.md): CastAvatar shows a person: a character (a round portrait from their identity sheet), or a creator (an initial until they add a picture), with their name and a one-line role.
- [CastStack](src/ui/CastStack/README.md): Who is in a take, at a glance: their faces overlapping, up to four, then +N for the rest. Use it for the people in a take, a clip or a scene at a glance, beside its name: up to four faces, then +N.
- [Checkbox](src/ui/Checkbox/README.md): Checkbox is one thing chosen or not, among others that may be chosen too: the files to queue, the rows to delete, the terms you agree to. Use it for choosing any number of things at once, or for one agreement: rows for a bulk action, files to queue, "I agree to the terms".
- [Chip](src/ui/Chip/README.md): Chip filters a feed by kind: All, Episodes, Shorts, Manga, Following. Use it for narrowing what a feed or a list shows, one kind at a time; with `variant="soft"`, picking several words from a set, such as traits.
- [ColorPicker](src/ui/ColorPicker/README.md): ColorPicker chooses any colour: a field for saturation and brightness, a hue track and the hex.
- [Contents](src/ui/Contents/README.md): Contents lists a document's sections in order, one press each: the sections of an open canon document under its row.
- [Cropper](src/ui/Cropper/README.md): A crop of a picture: a circle, a square or a box of the shot's own shape, moved over the whole picture. Use it to choose the part of a picture that is kept: an avatar from a face sheet or a variant, a logo's square.
- [DateField](src/ui/DateField/README.md): DateField picks a date, or a range of dates read by period: this month, the quarter, the dates on an invoice.
- [Dialog](src/ui/Dialog/README.md): Dialog is a window over the page on the web: pickers (references, opening frame, video plan), confirmations (story conflicts) and last checks (clip options). Use it for a task or a check that needs the page's whole attention on desktop: choosing references, a story conflict, the last check before something is spent or deleted.
- [DropZone](src/ui/DropZone/README.md): Where a file goes: drop or choose. Use it for where a file goes, dropped or chosen, then read and held: a clip to bring in.
- [EmptyState](src/ui/EmptyState/README.md): EmptyState stands in place of content while there is none: what is happening or what went wrong, in a sentence, then what can be done. Use it for the place where content would be while there is none: nothing yet, something being made, or something that failed.
- [FactList](src/ui/FactList/README.md): FactList pairs a quiet name with its value, two columns, values to the right. Use it for measured facts as a quiet name and its value (a colour match across a join, the length of a trimmed cut), and with `layout="grid"` who a character is at a point in the story.
- [Field](src/ui/Field/README.md): Field puts the form's label over a control that does not carry its own (a segmented control, chips, a group of options), with an optional hint under it.
- [FieldHelp](src/ui/FieldHelp/README.md): FieldHelp is the ⓘ beside a field name. Use it for the ⓘ beside a field's name that says what the field controls, in one bold line and examples: shot type, depth of field. With `examples`, for showing each case of a choice with its picture: how much a thing matters in a shot.
- [FloatingToolbar](src/ui/FloatingToolbar/README.md): FloatingToolbar sits over a selection and offers what can be done with it. Use it for what can be done with a selection: two or three ghost buttons just above it (Make it an event, Ask Maki), or with `count` the bar of what is selected in a list or a grid (3 selected: Move to…, Download, Delete).
- [FlowFooter](src/ui/FlowFooter/README.md): FlowFooter closes a step of the full-screen flow, inline under its content, or, where the step's body scrolls (New template, Edit template), placed by the flow under that body, outside the scroll, so it stays in view with the header above; the flow's layout does that, and FlowFooter itself is never sticky: Back on the left when a step precedes, then the note and the action on the right. Use it for the foot of a step in a full-screen flow: Back when a step precedes, a note on what happens next or what it costs, then the one primary action.
- [FlowHeader](src/ui/FlowHeader/README.md): FlowHeader is the full-screen flow's top bar: close (nothing is kept), what is being made and for what, the steps when there are several, then what sits at the end.
- [Icon](src/ui/Icon/README.md): Icon draws one glyph from AniCanon's outline icon set: 24px grid, 2px stroke, round caps and joins, `currentColor`. Use it for one glyph from AniCanon's outline set inside a control or beside words: a field's leading glyph, a tab bar item, a Studio panel's header.
- [IconButton](src/ui/IconButton/README.md): IconButton is a circular control holding one icon, with a required accessible `label`. Use it for an action that one glyph says better than a word: back, share, like, captions, the bell.
- [List](src/ui/List/README.md): List holds the rows of one list of things and names it: `ListRow`s, one thing per row. Use it around `ListRow`s, for one list of things that a screen reader should hear as a list.
- [ListRow](src/ui/ListRow/README.md): ListRow is one row of a `List`: a title and a quiet line under it, with an optional `icon` or `image` before it, a `meta` column (a timecode) and whatever sits at the end (a switch, a button, a check). Use it for one thing on one row of a `List`: a title and a quiet line, with what sits at the end (a switch, a button, a check); `loose` in settings lists.
- [Loader](src/ui/Loader/README.md): Sakuga's loader is a ball bouncing on twos, the first exercise every animator draws. Use it for something being made or loading whose length is unknown, in an app that sets no loader of its own.
- [MediaCard](src/ui/MediaCard/README.md): MediaCard shows one episode, short or manga issue: its artwork at its real shape, then a title and a metadata line.
- [Menu](src/ui/Menu/README.md): A menu behind a control, most often a ⋯ `IconButton`: rows of an icon and a label, left-aligned, each a link (`href`) or an action (`onClick`). Use it for the actions behind a ⋯: go somewhere (Face sheet and variants), or do something (Delete Smith). A `CastCard` opens one from its own ⋯ (`menu`); a full-screen flow puts its ⋯ at the end of its `FlowHeader`.
- [Notice](src/ui/Notice/README.md): A single line of context inside a page: something to know (info) or something that needs action (attention), with an optional action on the right.
- [NumberField](src/ui/NumberField/README.md): NumberField is a number you type or step a unit at a time: its name, a step down, the value with its unit, a step up. Use it for a number where one unit matters, typed or stepped a unit at a time: a 1px border, 2° of rotation, a font size.
- [OptionTiles](src/ui/OptionTiles/README.md): OptionTiles is the Studio's picker: a grid of tiles, each an AniCanon icon over a short name, for shot type, angle, depth, movement, mood, lighting, weather, effects and frame format. Use it for a choice that is clearer seen than read: Studio's direction pickers (shot, angle, lighting) as tiles, and with `size="lg"` the first choice of a flow, a pack or a plan as cards.
- [PageHeader](src/ui/PageHeader/README.md): PageHeader opens an app page: its `title`, the `lead` under it that says what the page holds, and at the end the page's view switch (`slot="views"`) and its one primary action (`slot="action"`). Use it for the top of an app page beside the SideNav (Characters, Places, Library, Series settings, You, Create): its title, its lead, and its view switch and main action.
- [Pagination](src/ui/Pagination/README.md): Pagination reads a long list a page at a time: what this page holds, then previous, the page numbers and next. Use it for reading a long list a page at a time, under the list it pages: productions at 24 a page, counted as "1–24 of 31 shorts".
- [Panel](src/ui/Panel/README.md): Panel is a Studio card: an AniCanon icon, a title, one line that explains it, an optional action, then its controls.
- [PanelRow](src/ui/PanelRow/README.md): PanelRow is Studio’s folded section: an icon, the section’s name and its current value, with the chevron that opens it, at the row's end with or without a value.
- [Picker](src/ui/Picker/README.md): Picker is the anchored chooser under a field: optional search, then options in groups. Use it for choosing one thing from many under a field, with search and groups: a cast member, a place, an event.
- [Popover](src/ui/Popover/README.md): Popover is a raised surface that floats over the page: a menu, a hover card, a small form. Use it for a raised surface anchored to what opened it: a menu, a hover card on a mention, a small form.
- [Progress](src/ui/Progress/README.md): Progress is how far something being made has come, as a line that fills in the accent. Use it for how far something being made has come, when the share done is known.
- [PropertyList](src/ui/PropertyList/README.md): PropertyList shows each kind of setting on one row with what it is set to; a row opens the full choice. Use it for each kind of setting on a row with what it is set to, where a row opens the full choice: Studio's direction for a panel (shot type, angle, lighting, lens).
- [ProviderButton](src/ui/ProviderButton/README.md): ProviderButton is the button for signing in with Apple or Google, in the provider's own mark and colours as each provider sets them.
- [Scrubber](src/ui/Scrubber/README.md): Scrubber shows and sets the playhead: played, buffered and remaining time, with the current time and total length. Use it for showing and setting the playhead of an episode or a short, over video or the player bar: played, buffered and remaining time, with chapter marks.
- [SearchField](src/ui/SearchField/README.md): A search: TextField's box with the search icon, a clear button once there are words, and, when the page passes `results`, Picker's options under it. Use it for finding something by its words: in a series, the library, all of AniCanon.
- [SectionHeader](src/ui/SectionHeader/README.md): SectionHeader opens a shelf: a heading, the line that explains what is on it, and an optional See all link. Use it for the heading that opens a shelf, with the line that says what is on it ("Shorts · videos under a minute") and an optional See all link.
- [SegmentedControl](src/ui/SegmentedControl/README.md): SegmentedControl switches between two to four views of the same thing: series sections, Following / For you, reading direction. Use it for switching between two to four views of the same thing (series sections, Following and For you), or a setting with two to four named values.
- [Select](src/ui/Select/README.md): A labelled single-choice control that opens a list. Use it for one choice from a short list of plain values, in a labelled field that opens the list: a faction, with its icon.
- [Sheet](src/ui/Sheet/README.md): Sheet is the bottom panel on phones for choices that belong to the current screen: audio and subtitles, reading direction.
- [SideNav](src/ui/SideNav/README.md): The creator sidebar: product, a switcher for the current workspace, grouped sections, a footer slot and the signed-in account at the bottom.
- [SidePanel](src/ui/SidePanel/README.md): SidePanel is the one container for a side area beside a view: an event, a character, a place, Maki.
- [SliderRow](src/ui/SliderRow/README.md): SliderRow is a labelled value on a track: the name, the track (0–100) and the readout as the creator reads it (`+0.2`, `−3 dB`, `100%`). Use it for a value set by feel on a track, with its readout in the unit people use: colour, volume, opacity and loudness in the editor.
- [StatusBar](src/ui/StatusBar/README.md): StatusBar is the slim bar at the foot of a working surface such as the writing room: where the work sits, whether it is saved, how long it is.
- [Stepper](src/ui/Stepper/README.md): Where a person is in a short multi-step flow: done steps get a check, the current one fills. Use it for where a person is in a short flow of three to five steps, in the top bar of a full-screen flow; `variant="bar"` on a phone.
- [SwatchPicker](src/ui/SwatchPicker/README.md): SwatchPicker chooses a colour by eye: round swatches, the chosen one ringed. Use it for a colour chosen by eye from round swatches: a skin tone, a creature's coat (Tabby, Calico).
- [Switch](src/ui/Switch/README.md): Switch turns one thing on or off, with its name as the `label` (the visible text sits beside it). Use it for one setting that takes effect the moment it changes: Loop this track, Name who speaks.
- [TabBar](src/ui/TabBar/README.md): TabBar is the phone's main navigation: a floating glass capsule with four destinations and a separate round Create button.
- [TagList](src/ui/TagList/README.md): TagList keeps words as tags: a character's visual vibe, the garments read from a photo. Use it for words kept as tags, each one removable and restorable: a character's visual vibe, the garments read from a photo.
- [Text](src/ui/Text/README.md): Text sets words in Sakuga's type scale: a `variant` names the style, `tone` changes only its colour. Use it for words on a board or in a component, set in Sakuga's type scale: titles, body, the caption line that explains, a field's name, an eyebrow.
- [TextField](src/ui/TextField/README.md): A labelled text input or text area. Use it for words a person types, on one line or in a text area: a name, a description, a search.
- [TextLink](src/ui/TextLink/README.md): TextLink is a quiet action inside a line or a row of text: Accept, Decline, Why; Ask Maki; Use it. Use it for a quiet action beside what it acts on, inside a line or a row of text (Accept, Decline, Why), and the way into a deletion.
- [Thumb](src/ui/Thumb/README.md): Thumb is a picture in a frame: cover-cropped, 6 px corners, `selected` adds the accent ring, `muted` greys a rejected take. Use it for a picture in a frame: a take (`selected`, or `muted` when rejected), a library item, a panel to pick, a frame not made yet.
- [Timeline](src/ui/Timeline/README.md): Timeline is the cut's tracks under the preview, shared by every production (episode or short, Quick or Directed). Use it for the cut's tracks under the preview: video, boards, overlays, sound, captions and effects in time, with the playhead and trim grips on the selected item.
- [Toast](src/ui/Toast/README.md): A short confirmation that something finished, rising into the window's lower right corner.
- [TopNav](src/ui/TopNav/README.md): TopNav is the desktop header: the AniCanon mark and wordmark, the main sections as text links, and search and account on the right. Use it for the desktop header: the AniCanon mark, up to five main sections (Home, Series, Shorts, Manga, Creators), search and the account.
- [VideoPlayer](src/ui/VideoPlayer/README.md): VideoPlayer is a clip played where it is shown: its picture, with play, the track, sound and full screen over it. Use it for a clip that plays where it is shown: a Library item, a landed take on Studio's stage.
- [Waveform](src/ui/Waveform/README.md): Waveform draws a sound as bars: a voice line, a take, a track in the cut, a generated sound option.

## AniCanonKit (`@anicanon/sakuga/anicanonkit`)

- [ActivityPanel](src/anicanonkit/ActivityPanel/README.md): The work in flight and the work waiting on you, in groups: running, needs you, earlier. Use it for the jobs running and waiting across a series, opened from the navigation's activity row.
- [ActivityRow](src/anicanonkit/ActivityRow/README.md): ActivityRow is the sidebar's line for work that is running: the AniCanon loader, how many jobs are running, the latest one's line, and a chevron that opens `ActivityPanel`.
- [AniCanonLoader](src/anicanonkit/AniCanonLoader/README.md): AniCanon's loader is its mark: the ring traces once around in the accent while the crescent and the moon dot stay exactly where the logo has them. Use it wherever AniCanon waits on something whose length is unknown, generating or loading.
- [AskMaki](src/anicanonkit/AskMaki/README.md): AskMaki is Maki's one button: Maki's face and a label. Use it for the one button that asks Maki: handed a conflict, a selection or a question at `size="sm"`, or in a view's header as the Maki pill with its count, which opens Maki's panel.
- [CanvasStage](src/anicanonkit/CanvasStage/README.md): CanvasStage is the editor's canvas while an item on it is selected: the frame, the item at its size and place, and a box with eight handles to move and resize it.
- [CastCard](src/anicanonkit/CastCard/README.md): A cast member on the cast page: the portrait (an initial until one is approved), the role, the name, what they have, and what is happening to them now.
- [CastGrid](src/anicanonkit/CastGrid/README.md): A faction's cast as `CastCard`s, six across on desktop. Use it for a faction's cast on the cast page: its `CastCard`s six across on desktop, each linking to the character's page.
- [CharacterCard](src/anicanonkit/CharacterCard/README.md): A character as one card: stage (silhouette, avatar or 9:16 portrait; 16:9 with `stage.creature`), role, name, stat tiles, traits, an optional listen-only voice and a note. Use it for a character as one card in every character flow (creation, editing, looks, voice and face): the stage, role, name, stats, traits and a note.
- [CharacterStats](src/anicanonkit/CharacterStats/README.md): Who a character is at a glance: each fact as its picker's icon, the value and what it is. Use it for who a character is at a glance: each fact as its picker's icon, the value and what it is, as tiles in a card or on a phone, or as pills across the character's page.
- [ChatMessage](src/anicanonkit/ChatMessage/README.md): ChatMessage is the person's own message in a chat with Maki: a neutral bubble at the right, in the same size as Maki's words.
- [CoverageTable](src/anicanonkit/CoverageTable/README.md): Wardrobe coverage: a row per character and a column per occasion the scripts ask for. Use it for wardrobe coverage across the cast: a row per character, a column per occasion the scripts ask for, and the gaps where a scene needs a look and nothing fits.
- [CutCell](src/anicanonkit/CutCell/README.md): CutCell is the cut number, with its approval: `approved` (filled check) or `waiting` (an empty ring). Use it for a cut's number with its approval, approved or waiting, and a short note under it such as the video it is (V3).
- [CutRow](src/anicanonkit/CutRow/README.md): CutRow is one cut (or video, or production) in a CutSheet. Use it for one cut, video or production as a row in a `CutSheet`, its cells in column order, banded while it is open beside the sheet.
- [CutSheet](src/anicanonkit/CutSheet/README.md): CutSheet is a scene read the way anime reads it: an ekonte sheet. Use it for a scene read as an ekonte sheet: numbered cuts as rows, columns set per view (Plan, Make, lists), rules between rows and no boxes.
- [DialogueLine](src/anicanonkit/DialogueLine/README.md): DialogueLine is a planned line: speaker, delivery, where it falls in the beat, the line in the spoken language and its translation.
- [EditorHeader](src/anicanonkit/EditorHeader/README.md): EditorHeader is the editor's top bar: what is being edited, its timecode, whether it rebuilds exactly, and the editor's actions.
- [EditorShell](src/anicanonkit/EditorShell/README.md): EditorShell is the full-screen editor (Cut). Use it for the full-screen editor (Cut, and Art and Lettering in manga): the rail, header, tool panel, inspector and the centre column with the monitor, program bar and timeline, with `focus` for the canvas alone.
- [EntityRow](src/anicanonkit/EntityRow/README.md): EntityRow is the one row kind on Story: a picture, the name, its state, and the work that told it. Use it for every row on Story: a character, a bond, a place, an event or a question, with its state and the work that told it.
- [EventGlyph](src/anicanonkit/EventGlyph/README.md): EventGlyph is the mark of an event type, the same everywhere a story event appears: map, scrubber, rows, mentions, pickers. Use it for the mark of a story event's type wherever one appears (map, scrubber, rows, mentions, pickers): event, twist, revelation, clue or goal.
- [FragmentBalance](src/anicanonkit/FragmentBalance/README.md): The Fragments balance in its places: a pill in top bars, a block in the sidebar, a held line while a generation is running, `inline`: the mark and an amount inside a sentence ("~520 is held when you start"), and `card`: the balance as a wallet card. Use it for the Fragments balance in its places: a pill in a top bar, a block in the sidebar, a hold while a generation runs, an amount inside a sentence ("~520 is held when you start"), and the wallet card that leads the Fragments page on desktop and phone.
- [FragmentSoul](src/anicanonkit/FragmentSoul/README.md): FragmentSoul is the Fragments currency mark: a hitodama spirit-flame in flat cel layers with a deep violet ink line. Use it for the mark every fragment amount carries: bare beside a balance figure, or seated in a medallion on its tinted disc.
- [IssueStrip](src/anicanonkit/IssueStrip/README.md): IssueStrip shows the issue as the reader turns it: the cover alone, then the content pages paired into spreads, with a rule at every page turn. Use it for the issue as the reader turns it, in Layout and under the editor's canvas: the cover alone, then the pages in spreads with a rule at every page turn.
- [LayerStrip](src/anicanonkit/LayerStrip/README.md): LayerStrip lists a page's layers by kind, in reading order, under the editor's canvas: panels, lettering, sound effects. Use it for a page's layers under the editor's canvas: panels, lettering and sound effects, a track per kind in reading order, with the issue strip on top.
- [LookPlate](src/anicanonkit/LookPlate/README.md): One look as a 9:16 plate on white, standing head to toe as the portrait is drawn, with its occasion (`creature`: 16:9, as a creature is drawn). Use it for one look as a 9:16 plate on white with its occasion, in each of its states: ready, wearing, drawing, waiting for review, or the plate that adds one.
- [MakiCard](src/anicanonkit/MakiCard/README.md): MakiCard is something Maki proposes or asks inside her reply: a story edit, a canon line, a section to add, a choice. Use it for something Maki proposes or asks inside her reply, with what was checked and its one pair of actions.
- [MakiComposer](src/anicanonkit/MakiComposer/README.md): MakiComposer is where the person writes to Maki: one container that holds what is asked about, the field and one set of controls.
- [MakiFinding](src/anicanonkit/MakiFinding/README.md): MakiFinding is one thing Maki's Review found, as a line of her reply: a small mark, what doesn't hold up and why, and every event it is in.
- [MakiFindingGroup](src/anicanonkit/MakiFindingGroup/README.md): MakiFindingGroup is one group of what Review found, inside Maki's reply: its label and count ("Conflicts · 2"), an optional quiet note, then its `MakiFinding`s.
- [MakiPanel](src/anicanonkit/MakiPanel/README.md): MakiPanel is Maki in a side area: a `SidePanel` with Maki's face and name, what is waiting, and close; the conversation; the composer at the foot. Use it for the chat with Maki beside a view, opened from the Maki button in the view's header.
- [MakiStep](src/anicanonkit/MakiStep/README.md): MakiStep is one line of what Maki is doing or did, at the top of her reply: "Read the story · 26 events".
- [MakiSuggestions](src/anicanonkit/MakiSuggestions/README.md): MakiSuggestions is what to ask Maki first, as rows that send on a press, phrased as the person would type them. Use it for the first things to ask, when nothing has been said yet in `MakiPanel`.
- [MakiTurn](src/anicanonkit/MakiTurn/README.md): MakiTurn is one reply from Maki: her words on the panel's edge, in `text-body-lg`, with no who-line and no box (the head already says who).
- [MangaPage](src/anicanonkit/MangaPage/README.md): MangaPage draws one page of an issue at its trim (1448 × 2048): its art once drawn, or its layout's frames before. Use it for one page of an issue at its trim: its art once drawn, its layout's frames before, or blank when it is not made yet, with a selection only on the editor's canvas.
- [Manuscript](src/anicanonkit/Manuscript/README.md): Manuscript is the script's page: its tools on top (the block type, where the cursor is), the sections, and what it reports under them (saved, length, Maki's check). Use it for the script's page, for episodes and manga issues alike: its tools on top, the numbered sections, and what it reports under them (saved, length, Maki's check).
- [ManuscriptSection](src/anicanonkit/ManuscriptSection/README.md): ManuscriptSection is one numbered section of a scene note or an imported script: #number, title (or a slugline with `slug`), the prose, the word count.
- [Mention](src/anicanonkit/Mention/README.md): Mention is a reference inside prose: `@` a character (filled), `#` a place (underlined), `&` an object (`kind="object"`, a hairline box, never broken across lines). Use it for a reference inside prose or a prompt: @ a character, # a place, $ a reference the creator added, ringed while its card is open.
- [MentionChip](src/anicanonkit/MentionChip/README.md): MentionChip shows who or what a panel holds: a cast member (@), a place (#) or a prop, with its picture and a quiet note. Use it for who or what a panel or a prompt holds: a cast member (@), a place (#), a reference ($) or a prop, with its picture and a quiet note such as the outfit and the emotion.
- [Monitor](src/anicanonkit/Monitor/README.md): Monitor is the editor's picture: the frame being edited, with its corner labels, the guides and the region an edit works on.
- [MonitorBar](src/anicanonkit/MonitorBar/README.md): MonitorBar is the bar under the editor's picture: the transport, the timecode, the edit buttons and what sits at the end.
- [PageWall](src/anicanonkit/PageWall/README.md): PageWall is Proof: every page of the issue at once, in spreads, each with its caption and how far it has come. Use it for the Proof view: every page of the issue at once in spreads, each with its caption and how far it has come (Laid out, Drawn, Lettered, Proofed).
- [PanelHeader](src/anicanonkit/PanelHeader/README.md): PanelHeader opens every side panel in Story with the same grammar: a small eyebrow naming what the panel shows, the title, an optional subtitle; icon actions (most common first, the rest in ⋯), then close. Use it for the head of every side panel in Story and of an inspector: an eyebrow, the title, an optional subtitle, icon actions, then close (none on the world panel or an inspector).
- [PanelSection](src/anicanonkit/PanelSection/README.md): PanelSection is a labelled group of rows with its count on the right ("Changes 3").
- [PlaceCard](src/anicanonkit/PlaceCard/README.md): The place or backdrop being made, on the left of its flow: its picture once drawn, or before that an empty frame naming what fills it (with the loader while it draws), its name, a quiet line under it, its facts and a note.
- [PremiereSlot](src/anicanonkit/PremiereSlot/README.md): PremiereSlot holds the place of something that is announced but not out yet: the next episode, the next manga issue. Use it for something announced but not out yet: the next episode or the next manga issue, with its premiere time ("Premieres Friday · 21:00") and Remind me.
- [ProductionNav](src/anicanonkit/ProductionNav/README.md): ProductionNav is the side bar inside a production (an episode, a short, and later a manga issue). Use it for the side bar inside a production (an episode, a short, a manga issue): its views, scenes and the facts that matter while making it, folding to a rail of views and tools in the editor.
- [ProgramBar](src/anicanonkit/ProgramBar/README.md): ProgramBar is the whole cut at a glance: sections in planned proportion (`cut`, `partial` with gaps, `missing`), the window the Timeline shows, the playhead, and numbered note `marks` from screening.
- [PromptComposer](src/anicanonkit/PromptComposer/README.md): PromptComposer is Studio's prompt: who and where it binds on top, the words, then its tools. Use it for the prompt that makes a take (in Studio, and for episodes in Quick mode): the cast, places and references it binds on top, the words, then its tools with Generate and its cost, `variant="media"` as the phone app's dock over the take and `variant="web"` as the phone browser's.
- [ProposalCard](src/anicanonkit/ProposalCard/README.md): ProposalCard is one event, change or link found in writing, waiting for the person. Use it for one event, change or link found in writing, waiting for the person beside the words it came from: stated, inferred, or a conflict with its Ask Maki.
- [QuestionRow](src/anicanonkit/QuestionRow/README.md): QuestionRow is one open question the audience is waiting on: planted → raised → answered, each step a real event with its place.
- [Readiness](src/anicanonkit/Readiness/README.md): What a character is ready with, at a glance on their page: looks, voice, face, props. Use it for what a character is ready with, at a glance on their page: looks, voice, face and props, each ticked or marked when it waits on the creator.
- [Revision](src/anicanonkit/Revision/README.md): Revision shows a proposed change in place: the old words struck, the new ones underlined. Use it for a proposed change shown in place, the old words struck and the new ones underlined, with Accept, Decline and Why beside it, or a new line where there was none.
- [ScreenplayEditor](src/anicanonkit/ScreenplayEditor/README.md): ScreenplayEditor is a scene written on the page: each block is a `ScreenplayLine` of its kind, typed in place, with no box around the words. Use it to write a scene of a script on the page, inside a `ManuscriptSection`, the blocks typed as screenplay lines.
- [ScreenplayLine](src/anicanonkit/ScreenplayLine/README.md): ScreenplayLine is one block of a screenplay inside a `ManuscriptSection`: `slug`, `action`, `cue` (with `extension` such as O.S.), `paren`, `dialogue`, `transition`. Use it for one block of a screenplay inside a section of the script: a slugline, action, a cue with its extension (O.S.), a parenthetical, dialogue or a transition.
- [Shorthand](src/anicanonkit/Shorthand/README.md): Shorthand is camera and timing notation as an ekonte writes it: shot size, angle, move and when it starts and stops (C.U · low · T.U 0+00 → 5+00).
- [Slip](src/anicanonkit/Slip/README.md): Slip is the correction slip, the only tinted surface on a sheet: the Director's revision note, a check, a review note pinned to a take, a story check.
- [SpendButton](src/anicanonkit/SpendButton/README.md): An action that spends fragments: Sakuga's `Button` with AniCanon's price after the label: the fragment mark and the amount, in regular weight and the muted ink, part of the one action with no rule between them. Use it for an action that spends fragments: Generate, Draw it again, Make the clip, Plan scene 5.
- [SpendTiles](src/anicanonkit/SpendTiles/README.md): `OptionTiles` whose large cards carry fragments: an option's `amount` (what a pack or plan gives, the card's headline) and `cost` (what choosing it charges, under its description), each with the fragment mark. Use it for a choice whose cards carry fragments: the Fragments packs and plans, and the first choice of a flow when each way costs something different.
- [Stages](src/anicanonkit/Stages/README.md): A job's stages in order, while it runs and after: done ones ticked with the time they took, the running one with AniCanon's loader, the rest numbered. Use it for a job's stages in order, while it runs and after: done ones with the time they took, the running one with AniCanon's loader, a failed one with why ("Designing the first look").
- [StateChange](src/anicanonkit/StateChange/README.md): StateChange is a change written as before → after: two badges, the before faded. Use it for a change written as before and after, two badges with the before faded: a place that starts burning, a bond that turns to rivals.
- [StoryMap](src/anicanonkit/StoryMap/README.md): StoryMap draws the story on a canvas you move: characters (portraits) and places (art) are hubs; events are small shapes, linked to the hubs they involve. Use it for the story drawn as hubs and events on a canvas: characters and places as hubs, events on a thread in story order, and a selection's causes and conflicts.
- [StoryScrubber](src/anicanonkit/StoryScrubber/README.md): StoryScrubber moves through the story in story order (when things happen in the world, not when they were released). Use it for moving through the story in story order, when things happen in the world: a column per event under arc brackets, and a handle that names the moment ("After Fire at Sé").
- [Timesheet](src/anicanonkit/Timesheet/README.md): Timesheet is what gets generated for a cut, on a frame grid (24 a second, a tick on each whole second, the strip's two ends its first and last frames): each video's bracket, the key frames it starts and ends on, and one line per video (where it opens, how it continues).
- [TrimFrames](src/anicanonkit/TrimFrames/README.md): TrimFrames shows a cut’s in and out frames with their timecodes and a frame-at-a-time nudge under each. Use it for the selected cut's in and out frames with their timecodes and a frame-at-a-time nudge under each, ringing the one being trimmed.
- [ViewHeader](src/anicanonkit/ViewHeader/README.md): ViewHeader opens a production view: which view it is, its title and its meta, with the view's actions on the right. Use it for the top of a production view: the view as an eyebrow, the title on one line, the meta under it, and the view's actions on the right (Maki, then at most one primary).
- [VoiceTiles](src/anicanonkit/VoiceTiles/README.md): Voices to cast from, each a tile with its name and a few words on how it sounds ("Bright, determined"). Use it for casting a voice: a tile per voice with its name and a few words on how it sounds ("Bright, determined"), where choosing one plays it and selects it.
- [VolumeControl](src/anicanonkit/VolumeControl/README.md): VolumeControl is a sound’s mute button, its level and the readout (Muted when muted).
